title: Explain authorized operational SLA calendar and active pause source evidence in selected Command work item
goal: Complete a bounded Class-0 CAP-CMD-105 source-owned SLA explanation by exposing optional calendar source, active paused time and pause reason in the existing selected work-item JSON/native HTML, with independent host source authorization; no policy inference or Class-2 operation.
invariants: Canonical product CAP-CMD-105 Command operational SLA, CAP-CMD-101 selected Work Queue consumer; SLA policy/calendar and source data remain owned by independently authorized host adapter.
Git parent PR #174 frozen b1238eb29e3e51dade0166e93de9819f5e3ba334 is NOT engineering parent E10-CMD-105.
Class-0 source-reported calendar and pause history only. OPEN-013 Class-2 pause/resume/create follow-up explicitly excluded.
No invented default calendar, source policy duration, SLA threshold, pause justification, eligibility or new Customer object.
Same GET /command/work-queue, same selected and owner-authorized single item, no new authorization model.
security_properties: Source calendar and pause reason only come from independently source-authorizing SLAOwner called AFTER host session and current-page selection ACL.
Invalid contradictory or injected source claim fails generic 503 with no selected item/provenance body; HTML template escapes source text.
No selected work item => no extra SLA adapter call; zero cross-tenant/foreign source lookups.

migration.rationale: Additive optional source-reported metadata on existing read-only selected SLA projection; no schema/storage mutation.

rollback.strategy: Drop optional source metadata and HTML display while preserving prior CAP-CMD-105A state and host contract.
verification: Parent Work Queue six-view and source-authorized SLA tests still pass.

Host-authorized selected-only SLA in PR #174 SHA b1238eb29e3e51dade0166e93de9819f5e3ba334, both exact-HEAD workflows SUCCESS, L2 pending and PR still draft.

Exact-SHA command-work-queue-runtime Go Linux/macOS/Windows and unchanged mandatory engineering-kernel security, architecture and SAST gates must pass before merge.
